items.html: Thus they are found to be ten Sefirot, hidden in the utmost concealment, and the E"S clothes within them, and they are Atik and the RDL"A. And beneath it, nine Sefirot from Keter to Yesod, called by the name AA. And among them all, they are the ten Sefirot that are the root, source, and vitality of all of Atzilut.
